description: Recompute an HMAC over a raw webhook payload and compare it to a provided signature, the check every webhook receiver (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, etc.) has to do before trusting a request. Accepts a signature with or without the common "sha256=" prefix style, and matches against either hex or base64 encoding since providers differ on which they send.

algorithm.description: The HMAC hash algorithm the signature was computed with (default sha256)

payload.description: The raw webhook request body, exactly as received (do not re-serialize JSON)

signature.description: The signature to verify, with or without a "sha256=" style prefix, hex or base64 encoded

name: verify_webhook_signature
